  passwordHash = '$2b$10$MiIc4jUi1n7F8SN7aHf2n.UxU/IrkrNHTUEOb5ZjN9jVct5sF5S1u'
WHERE name = 'jiang';

SELECT id, name, username, 
  CASE WHEN passwordHash IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as has_password
FROM users 
WHERE name = 'jiang';
